reason: The plugin is primarily a DSH web session-management interface: it adds a settings panel for listing all existing and archived sessions and lets users archive, unarchive, delete, search, and batch-manage them. Its user-facing purpose is organizing session lifecycle from the settings UI, supported by explicit HTTP endpoints for the same operations, so it is best classified as a navigation/management panel utility with moderate data-loss risk due to permanent deletion.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 设置界面提供会话管理入口，用于集中查看现有与归档会话，并支持归档、取消归档、删除、搜索和批量操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a session management page in DSH Web settings to view active and archived sessions and perform archive, unarchive, delete, search, and batch operations.

capabilities: Expose plugin HTTP endpoints for session actions

reasons.code: README describes a settings panel for viewing all sessions (active + archived) with archive, unarchive, delete, search, and batch actions.
README documents API routes for listing sessions and mutating session state, including a permanent delete operation.
Package metadata indicates a web plugin entry with host/client integration, confirming a UI-facing extension model within DSH.

capabilities: Expose plugin HTTP endpoints for session actions
